title: DOWNTOWN
body:
Downtown revitalization is complete. Every barrel is now
explosive and every drone is now judgmental. The robots
have installed drone hives in the old town: they print
Swarmers and Barrel Bots faster than you can be rude
about them. Burn the hives out, one district at a time --
each one you kill shuts down a street lock. The exit is
in the gate square, behind the last hive. Mind the barrels.
